title: Standing Spray — Classic White
summary: An easel-mounted standing spray of white lilies, roses and chrysanthemums with soft greenery for a service.
descriptionHtml:
A dignified standing spray designed for funeral services and memorials, arranged on a floral easel so it stands beautifully beside the casket or at the front of the room. White oriental lilies, roses and chrysanthemums are gathered with lush greenery for a calm, timeless presence.

Our team prepares each tribute by hand and can coordinate delivery to the service on your behalf, so you have one less thing to think about during a difficult time.

  • Style: One-sided spray on a wire easel
  • Palette: All-white with fresh greenery
  • Presentation: Ready to display on arrival; ribbon banner available on request
  • Care: Keep out of direct sun and away from heat until the service
seoTitle: Standing Spray Classic White | Sympathy Flowers JA
seoDescription: Classic white standing spray of lilies and roses on an easel. Sympathy flowers in Jamaica, delivered across Kingston & St. Andrew.
careInstructions: Keep the easel upright in a cool spot away from direct sunlight and heat until the service.
deliveryNote: Delivery to homes, churches, or funeral homes across Kingston & St. Andrew can be arranged; timing is coordinated with the service and subject to availability.
wholesaleNote: Corporate and funeral-home accounts can arrange standing orders for recurring services; contact us to set up trade terms.
availabilityNote: Flower varieties may vary with seasonal availability while keeping the all-white style.
